name: instagram-edits-mcp
description: Local, hardened MCP server for Instagram Edits for Mac: the full dynamic tool set kept in sync, loopback-only, signature-checked, with a read-only mode and tool policies. Token kept in the keychain.

edits_token.title: Edits access token
edits_token.description: In Edits: Settings > Automation > Enable Automation Server, then copy the Access token. Claude Code stores it in your system keychain; never paste it into a chat.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only list and allow tools that read state (appState, projects, get*, list*, ...). Nothing in Edits can be changed.
